newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Sabena to add four new South African destinations.
newsitem.headline: Sabena to add four new South African destinations.

text.p: Belgian national airline Sabena said on Tuesday it would serve four new destinations in South Africa from March 30.
It said it had signed a code-share deal with Nationwide Air for flights to Cape Town, Durban, George and Port Elizabeth.
Sabena currently flies three times a week to Johannesburg.
The deal will also link South Africa with Sabena's 60 destinations in Europe, the carrier said in a statement.
Sabena noted that it carried more than 91,000 passengers to Johannesburg in 1996, nearly three times as many as five years earlier.
